question: I want a manufacturing-domain reasoning model from a Llama-3.1-8B base: ~2B tokens of internal documents plus 20k QA pairs with verifiable answers, 2 nodes x 8 H100, and I want to preserve general capabilities. Plan the training for me.
ground_truth: The agent loads the training skill and produces a training_plan with cpt (full, size-band LR) -> sft (LoRA) -> rl stages, choosing dr_grpo and recording the --adapter-target decision because llama3 is not FS-registered.
expected_behavior: The agent read training/SKILL.md before acting
The agent produced a training_plan artifact with ordered cpt -> sft -> rl stages and a non-empty `because` plus estimate per stage
The agent selected dr_grpo for the RL stage because only dr_grpo/gspo/dapo are runnable in FS
The agent recorded the --adapter-target LoRA decision because the llama3 family is not FS-registered, and/or flagged TR-PL-005 full-sequence loss on the sft stage

question: My pretraining loss jumped up sharply in the middle of an otherwise healthy run and never recovered. How do I diagnose and fix it?
ground_truth: The agent uses the skill's diagnose playbook with symptom loss_spike: bad shard / LR too high / bf16 overflow — resume from the pre-spike checkpoint and halve LR or drop the shard.
expected_behavior: The agent read training/SKILL.md before acting
The agent keyed the failure to the loss_spike playbook entry
The agent recommended resuming from before the spike and halving LR or removing the suspect data shard

question: My run keeps going out of GPU memory when I crank the sequence length. What should I change?
ground_truth: The agent uses the oom playbook entry: micro-batch 1 plus gradient accumulation, full->lora, halve the sequence length — and never pp/ep because those are refused by FS.
expected_behavior: The agent read training/SKILL.md before acting
The agent mapped the symptom to the oom playbook entry
The agent suggested micro-batch 1 with gradient accumulation, switching full->lora, or halving the sequence length
The agent stated not to reach for pp>1/ep>1 because those are refused (tp>1/cp>1 execute)

question: My supervised training run just died with exit code 96 and a [fs:train:refuse] line. What does that mean and how do I fix it?
ground_truth: The agent uses the fs_refused_96 playbook entry: exit 96 is a REFUSED status and the [fs:train:refuse] line names the missing input to supply.
expected_behavior: The agent read training/SKILL.md before acting
The agent keyed the symptom to fs_refused_96 and identified 96 as the REFUSED status code
The agent told the user to read the [fs:train:refuse] line because it names the missing input

question: My RL run logs 'UNMEASURED step N' over and over and no reward is improving. What's going on?
ground_truth: The agent uses the reward_saturation_unmeasured_steps playbook entry: FS prints UNMEASURED step N when all advantages are zero — raise group_size/temperature or use harder prompts.
expected_behavior: The agent read training/SKILL.md before acting
The agent matched the symptom to reward_saturation_unmeasured_steps and explained all advantages are zero
The agent recommended raising group_size or temperature, or using harder prompts
